title: Research: flag-1 head-step repair co-hosts at update 2797 for exactly two added rank units (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451) shows that on present-head flag 1 (`X0` → `Y7`, head `232`) no published `Y7` update co-hosts the basis head. [#3508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3508) gave a **zero-added-mass** repair for flag 43. This package shows flag 1 is different: the delivering update can be repaired, but every checked repair costs at least **+2 rank mass**.

Event 2797 (`Y7 += D17/4`) is the only `Y7` update that carries `X0` (coefficient `-1/2`, the final value). Two concrete schedules make that ADD co-host the head while `X0` is still live; both pass the published `check_native.validate()` unchanged.

| | Events | ADDs | Transports | Rank mass | Profile delta | Surcharge on |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| **R0** (order-preserving) | +1 | 0 | +1 | **+2** | `-H1 + 2H2 + H5 - H6` | `D17` |
| **R1** (relocated into `D17`'s full window) | 0 | 0 | 0 | **+2** | `H8 - H6` | `Y7` |

Under an affine price the extra cost is positive (`a+2b` / `2b`). Under convex `H=r²`, R0's profile delta is `-4` (rank mass still +2).

**Obstruction.** The #3508 head-closure rule blocks all six `Y7` updates (first blocker for 2797 is `Y8` at 2799). An exact least-frame sweep shows zero added non-private mass infeasible for all 6 order-preserving updates and for 868 of 1,115 relocation slots before event 3366. Excess over the floor is always even, so **+2 is the floor** in those classes; R0 is mass-optimal among order-preserving repairs. 247 later relocation slots remain open (scoped floor, not a global relocation floor).

**Scoped repair bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Does not reprint #3451 drop/arrive chronology.

## Result

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-flag1-head-step-repair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag1-head-step-repair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag1-head-step-repair/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag1-head-step-repair/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag1-head-step-repair
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_FLAG1_HEAD_STEP_REPAIR flag=1 head=232 delivering_update=2797 R0=order_preserving added_events=1 added_adds=0 added_transports=1 added_rank_mass=2 profile_delta=-H1+2H2+H5-H6 R1=relocated added_events=0 added_transports=0 added_rank_mass=2 profile_delta=-H6+H8 native_validate=PASS zero_mass_order_preserving=0/6 zero_mass_relocation_obstructed=868/1115 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG1_HEAD_STEP_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT … rows_equal=280/280 … zero_mass_relocation_obstructed=868/1115 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG1_HEAD_STEP_REPAIR_TESTS cases=17 clean_read_only=1 scanners=2
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-flag1-head-step-repair outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451) (flag 1 obstruction; this answers its repair OQ), [#3508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3508) (flag 43 zero-mass method prior; flag 1 has a different floor). Soft-overlap: verify/independent reuse helper/splice structure from #3508; scientific novelty is the +2 floor and 0/6 zero-mass obstruction. Soft-overlap checked against open [#3363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3363) (only the single `-1/2` delivery at 2797 is used). Does not reopen #3456/#3443/#3441/#3436/#3421/#3411/#3392, deferred peeled-leaf/rho=0/V45, or the merged readout series through #2883.
